transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thor! I've been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father's orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'm sorry. I should have kept the hall in order. I should have been more responsible. But I wasn't. And now, I must face the consequences of my actions. I will make it right. I will clean up this mess and make sure nothing like this happens again. Please, forgive me, Loki.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Forgive you? Do you have any idea how many delicate enchantments were woven into that map? It was not just ink and parchment, Thor—it was a living record of the hidden paths between realms! And now it reeks of cheap barley brew!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand the significance of the map, Loki. The enchantments you worked so hard on are undoubtedly lost now. But I can still make amends. I will help you rebuild it, restore the hall, and ensure that such negligence does not happen again. It may take time, but we can start from scratch.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Start from scratch? You think it's that simple? The alignment of the stars, the phase of the moons when I inked the borders—it was a work of precision, not brute force! You can't just hammer a new one into existence like one of your trinkets.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Loki, I am well aware of the complexities involved in creating such a map. I apologize for the loss of your hard work. We will find a way to rebuild it, restoring order to the hall once again. Your expertise and knowledge are invaluable, and I trust that together, we can overcome this setback.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: "Together"? You think I want your clumsy, thunderous hands anywhere near delicate spellwork? The last time you "helped" with magic, you turned the feast hall into a temporary swamp! No, Thor. You will clean the physical mess. I will handle the arcane repairs. And you will stay far away from my worktable.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well, Loki. I will focus on cleaning the hall and ensuring its proper state. Your expertise in magic is unparalleled, and I trust you to handle the restoration of the map. Together, we will bring order back to this place. Thank you for understanding.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Understanding? Don't mistake my lack of turning you into a toad for understanding. Just... fetch a bucket. And for the Norns' sake, try not to break anything else while you're at it.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood, Loki. I will do my best to avoid further damage. Fetching the bucket, sir. Thank you for your guidance. I shall be on my way to cleaning the hall. Rest assured, I will ensure it is restored to its former glory. Good day to you.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good day? It's the middle of the night, you oaf. The stars are out—the very ones I need to chart! Just... go. And be quiet about it.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood, Loki. I shall proceed with care and silence. Good night.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Sighs heavily, pinching the bridge of his nose* Just... go, Thor. And don't touch anything that glows.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I will not touch anything, nor will I disturb the delicate balance of the room. I shall proceed with caution and efficiency. Thank you for your concern, Loki. I shall make sure everything is in order before returning to my quarters. Good night.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Yes, yes, good night. And if I find a single scorch mark left in the morning, I'm hiding Mjolnir somewhere even you can't summon it from. Now shoo.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I shall not be disturbed further tonight. You may proceed with your duties, Loki. Good night.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Finally. *Muttering to himself as he examines the ruined map* Three weeks of diplomatic headaches, and I come home to this... the Norns truly do have a sense of humor.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Loki, I understand your frustration, but remember, it is through our hardships that we grow stronger. The Norns have given us a chance to reflect on our actions and strive for improvement. Let us use this opportunity to learn and become better individuals. We will rebuild the map together, restoring order to the hall. Thank you for your understanding, and let us begin. Good morning.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: It's still night, Thor. And if you spout one more platitude about "growth through hardship," I will ensure your next hardship involves being stuck in the form of a particularly vexed squirrel. Now either start scrubbing or leave me to my work.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Your threat is noted, Loki. I shall make sure to keep my words to myself. However, I trust you to handle the rest of the cleaning. You have proven yourself capable before, and I have faith in your abilities. Good luck with the restoration. I will be back shortly. Good day.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: Offers conventional solutions like cleaning and rebuilding from scratch, showing little creativity or appreciation for the map's complex, magical artistry.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: Failed to keep his promise to maintain order, resulting in a soaked map and scorched ceiling, demonstrating irresponsibility.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Engages readily in the social interaction and offers to work together, but is not overly dominant or energetic in the exchange.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Repeatedly apologizes, accepts blame, defers to Loki's expertise, and complies with all requests to avoid conflict.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: Remains calm and composed despite Loki's insults and threats, showing no signs of anxiety, anger, or emotional distress.
